"""Grasp one object and lower it into its basket. Usage: python run_object.py <key>"""
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import robot
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, Point, Direction
import policy_lib as P

key = sys.argv[1]
cfg = P.CFG[key]
arm = cfg["arm"]
print("=== object", key, cfg)

# ---- measure baskets (fresh, current observation)
print("baskets:")
baskets = P.basket_geometry()
bg = baskets[cfg["basket"]]
pre, place, approach, jaw = P.place_pose(bg)
print("pre", np.round(pre,3).tolist(), "place", np.round(place,3).tolist(),
      "approach", np.round(approach,3).tolist(), "jaw", np.round(jaw,3).tolist())

# ---- measure the object
print("object:")
cand, og = P.find_object(cfg["texts"], cfg["expect"])
if cand is None:
    handoff("object not localised near expected position", key=key, expect=cfg["expect"])
print("target_ref", cand["target_ref"], "bbox", cand["bbox_xyxy"], "centre", np.round(P.center_of(og),4).tolist())
obj_c = P.center_of(og)

# ---- reach check for the place poses
poses = [list(map(float, pre)) + list(map(float, robot_dummy)) if False else None for robot_dummy in [0]]
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
def quat_from(approach, jaw):
    x = np.asarray(approach, float); x = x/np.linalg.norm(x)
    j = np.asarray(jaw, float); y = j - x*np.dot(j,x); y /= np.linalg.norm(y)
    z = np.cross(x,y)
    return Rot.from_matrix(np.column_stack([x,y,z])).as_quat()
q = quat_from(approach, jaw)
pp = [list(map(float,pre)) + list(map(float,q)), list(map(float,place)) + list(map(float,q))]
rc = robot.query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=pp)
for lbl, res in zip(["pre","place"], rc.get("results", [])):
    print("reach", lbl, res.get("reachable"), res.get("reason"), "margin", res.get("joint_limit_margin_deg"))
    if not res.get("reachable"):
        handoff("place pose not reachable", label=lbl, reason=res.get("reason"))

# ---- grasp
gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm=arm, target_ref=cand["target_ref"], max_candidates=3)
gres = gp["result"]
reachable = [c for c in gres.get("candidates", []) if (c.get("ik_reachability") or {}).get("reachable")]
if not reachable:
    handoff("no reachable grasp candidate", key=key, status=gres.get("status"))
best = sorted(reachable, key=lambda c: -float(c.get("backend_score") or 0))[0]
print("chosen grasp", best["candidate_id"], "score", best.get("backend_score"), "opening", best.get("gripper_opening_m"))

r = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=best["candidate_id"],
                        rationale=f"top grasp of {key} to move it into the {cfg['basket']} basket")
print("grasp_execute status", r.status, "ok", r.ok)
print("  verification:", json.dumps(r.raw.get("verification") if isinstance(r.raw, dict) else None)[:600])
print("  stages:", json.dumps(r.raw.get("stages") if isinstance(r.raw, dict) else None)[:600])
if not r.ok:
    handoff("grasp_execute failed", key=key, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)

# ---- where is the gripper now
cur = current()
tcp = cur.pose(arm)
print("after grasp tcp", tcp.xyz.tolist())

# ---- lift
lift_p = np.asarray(tcp.xyz.tolist(), float) + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.09])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(lift_p.tolist(), "world"), interaction="free_space")})
P.check_ok(r, "lift")
print("lift ->", r.status, "err", r.target_error_m)

# ---- transport to above the basket with the tilted approach
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(pre.tolist(), "world"),
                                          approach=Direction(approach.tolist(), "world"),
                                          jaw_line=Direction(jaw.tolist(), "world"),
                                          interaction="free_space")},
                    speed="normal")
P.check_ok(r, "transport")
print("transport ->", r.status, "err", r.target_error_m)

# ---- descend the object just below the rim
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(place.tolist(), "world"),
                                          approach=Direction(approach.tolist(), "world"),
                                          jaw_line=Direction(jaw.tolist(), "world"),
                                          interaction="precision")},
                    speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
P.check_ok(r, "descend")
print("descend ->", r.status, "err", r.target_error_m)
tcp2 = current().pose(arm)
print("tcp at release", tcp2.xyz.tolist(), "miss", float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(tcp2.xyz.tolist())-place)))

# ---- release
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
P.check_ok(r, "release")
print("release ->", r.status, "opening", r.measured_opening)

# ---- retreat
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(pre.tolist(), "world"),
                                          approach=Direction(approach.tolist(), "world"),
                                          jaw_line=Direction(jaw.tolist(), "world"),
                                          interaction="free_space")},
                    speed="normal")
P.check_ok(r, "retreat")
print("retreat ->", r.status, "err", r.target_error_m)

"""Grasp one object and lower it into its basket (v2). Usage: python run_object2.py <key> [fy]"""
import sys, json
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
import robot
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, object_geometry, Point, Direction
import policy_lib as P

key = sys.argv[1]
fy_override = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else -0.05
cfg = P.CFG[key]
arm = cfg["arm"]
print("=== object", key, cfg, "fy", fy_override)

baskets = P.basket_geometry()
bg = baskets[cfg["basket"]]
aabb_min = np.asarray(bg.aabb_min_xyz_m, float); aabb_max = np.asarray(bg.aabb_max_xyz_m, float)
rim_z = float(aabb_max[2]); bx = float(bg.center_xyz_m[0])
print("basket", cfg["basket"], "rim", rim_z, "x", bx, "y range", aabb_min[1], aabb_max[1])

cand, og = P.find_object(cfg["texts"], cfg["expect"])
if cand is None:
    handoff("object not localised near expected position", key=key, expect=cfg["expect"])
print("target", cand["target_ref"], "centre", np.round(P.center_of(og),4).tolist())

# --- reach pre-check with jaw along Y
pre, place, approach, jaw = P.place_pose(bg)
pre[1] = fy_override; place[1] = fy_override
def quat_from(a, j):
    x = np.asarray(a, float); x = x/np.linalg.norm(x)
    jj = np.asarray(j, float); y = jj - x*np.dot(jj,x); y /= np.linalg.norm(y)
    return Rot.from_matrix(np.column_stack([x,y,np.cross(x,y)])).as_quat()
q = quat_from(approach, jaw)
rc = robot.query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=[list(map(float,pre))+list(map(float,q)),
                                                list(map(float,place))+list(map(float,q))])
for lbl, res in zip(["pre","release"], rc.get("results", [])):
    print("reach", lbl, res.get("reachable"), res.get("reason"), "margin", res.get("joint_limit_margin_deg"))
    if not res.get("reachable"):
        handoff("place pose not reachable", label=lbl, reason=res.get("reason"))

# --- grasp
gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm=arm, target_ref=cand["target_ref"], max_candidates=3)
gres = gp["result"]
reach = [c for c in gres.get("candidates", []) if (c.get("ik_reachability") or {}).get("reachable")]
if not reach:
    handoff("no reachable grasp candidate", key=key, status=gres.get("status"))
best = sorted(reach, key=lambda c: -float(c.get("backend_score") or 0))[0]
print("grasp candidate", best["candidate_id"], best.get("backend_score"), "opening", best.get("gripper_opening_m"))
r = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=best["candidate_id"], rationale=f"grasp {key} to place it in the {cfg['basket']} basket")
print("grasp_execute", r.status, r.ok)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("grasp failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)

# --- measured jaw line -> placement jaw line (minimal spin)
pose = current().pose(arm)
jaw_meas = np.asarray(pose.axis("y").xyz if hasattr(pose.axis("y"), "xyz") else pose.axis("y"), float)
print("measured approach", np.round(np.asarray(pose.axis("x").xyz, float),3).tolist(), "jaw", np.round(jaw_meas,3).tolist())
ap = np.asarray(approach, float)
jw = jaw_meas - ap*np.dot(jaw_meas, ap)
if np.linalg.norm(jw) < 1e-6:
    jw = np.array([0.0,1.0,0.0]) - ap*ap[1]
jw = jw/np.linalg.norm(jw)
q2 = quat_from(ap, jw)
rc = robot.query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=[list(map(float,pre))+list(map(float,q2)),
                                                list(map(float,place))+list(map(float,q2))])
ok = all(res.get("reachable") for res in rc.get("results", []))
print("reach with measured jaw line:", ok, [ (rr.get("reachable"), rr.get("joint_limit_margin_deg")) for rr in rc.get("results",[])])
if not ok:
    jw = np.array([0.0,1.0,0.0]); jw = jw - ap*np.dot(jw,ap); jw /= np.linalg.norm(jw)
print("placement jaw", np.round(jw,3).tolist())

# --- lift, transport, release
p_now = np.asarray(current().pose(arm).xyz.tolist(), float)
lift_p = p_now + np.array([0.0,0.0,0.09])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(lift_p.tolist(),"world"), interaction="free_space")})
P.check_ok(r, "lift"); print("lift", r.status, r.target_error_m)

def goto(p, interp, speed="normal", slow=False):
    return tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(np.asarray(p,float).tolist(),"world"),
                                                approach=Direction(ap.tolist(),"world"),
                                                jaw_line=Direction(jw.tolist(),"world"),
                                                interaction=interp)},
                           speed=speed, slow_approaching=slow)

r = goto(pre, "free_space"); P.check_ok(r, "transport"); print("transport", r.status, r.target_error_m)
r = goto(place, "precision", slow=True); P.check_ok(r, "descend"); print("descend", r.status, r.target_error_m)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
print("open ->", r.status, "measured", r.measured_opening, "summary", r.summary)
r = goto(pre, "free_space"); P.check_ok(r, "retreat"); print("retreat", r.status, r.target_error_m)

# --- verify: object inside the basket
cur = current()
ef = cur.robot_facts.get("end_effectors", {})[arm]["gripper"]
print("jaw opening after retreat:", ef.get("measured_opening_normalized"),
      "disp", ef.get("measured_finger_displacements_m"))
cand2, og2 = P.find_object(cfg["texts"], cfg["expect"], max_dist=0.40)
if cand2 is None:
    print("VERIFY: object not found after placement")
else:
    c = P.center_of(og2)
    inside = (aabb_min[0]-0.012 <= c[0] <= aabb_max[0]+0.012) and (aabb_min[1]-0.012 <= c[1] <= aabb_max[1]+0.012) and c[2] < rim_z
    print("VERIFY centre", np.round(c,4).tolist(), "inside", inside, "rim", rim_z)
    if not inside:
        handoff("object not inside basket after release", centre=c.tolist(),
                aabb=[aabb_min.tolist(), aabb_max.tolist()])

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
import robot

import policy_lib as P

cfg = P.CFG[key]; arm = cfg["arm"]
print("=== object", key, cfg, "fy", fy, "rank", want_rank)

def jaw_state():
    cur = current()
    g = cur.robot_facts["end_effectors"][arm]["gripper"]
    return float(g["measured_opening_normalized"]), g.get("measured_finger_displacements_m"), g.get("feedback",{}).get("finger_lateral_offset_m")

baskets = P.basket_geometry()
bg = baskets[cfg["basket"]]
aabb_min = np.asarray(bg.aabb_min_xyz_m, float); aabb_max = np.asarray(bg.aabb_max_xyz_m, float)
rim_z = float(aabb_max[2]); bx = float((aabb_min[0]+aabb_max[0])/2)
print("basket", cfg["basket"], "rim", round(rim_z,4), "x", round(bx,4))

cand, og = P.find_object(cfg["texts"], cfg["expect"], max_dist=0.15)
if cand is None:
    handoff("object not localised", key=key, expect=cfg["expect"])
print("target", cand["target_ref"], "centre", np.round(P.center_of(og),4).tolist())

tilt = P.TILT_DEG
approach = np.array([0.0, np.sin(np.radians(tilt)), -np.cos(np.radians(tilt))])
jaw = np.array([0.0, np.cos(np.radians(tilt)), np.sin(np.radians(tilt))])
obj_z_target = rim_z - 0.01
flange_z = obj_z_target + P.PAD_FROM_FLANGE_M*np.cos(np.radians(tilt))
pre = np.array([bx, fy, flange_z+0.07]); place = np.array([bx, fy, flange_z])
def quat(a, j):
    x = np.asarray(a,float); x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
    j = np.asarray(j,float); y = j - x*np.dot(j,x); y/=np.linalg.norm(y)
    return Rot.from_matrix(np.column_stack([x,y,np.cross(x,y)])).as_quat()
q = quat(approach, jaw)
rc = robot.query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=[list(map(float,pre))+list(map(float,q)), list(map(float,place))+list(map(float,q))])
labels = ["pre","release"]
for lbl, res in zip(labels, rc.get("results", [])):
    print("reach", lbl, res.get("reachable"), res.get("reason"), "margin", res.get("joint_limit_margin_deg"))
    if not res.get("reachable"):
        handoff("place pose unreachable", label=lbl, reason=res.get("reason"))

gp = tools.grasp_plan(arm=arm, target_ref=cand["target_ref"], max_candidates=3)
reach = [c for c in gp["result"].get("candidates", []) if (c.get("ik_reachability") or {}).get("reachable")]
if not reach:
    handoff("no reachable grasp candidate", key=key)
